newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET PLANS BOARD MACHINE OPS RESTRUCTURE.
newsitem.headline: VALMET PLANS BOARD MACHINE OPS RESTRUCTURE.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Monday it had started talks with staff to move its Tampere board machine operations to other units and sub-contractors.

It did not give any estimate on planned savings or increased productivity. A Valmet official said by telephone that negotiations would take at least six weeks and that the issue was so large that it would be decided by the group board.
"This is such an issue and (it is) at such an early stage that I cannot possibly give any details in advance," Valmet vice president Pertti Helin told Reuters.
Valmet said in its statement that concentrating board machine operations was a continuation of its strategic development and would "further improve productivity development and competitiveness".
Valmet also has board machine operations in Karlstad in southern Sweden, it said.
